en: Continue the game?{KN}

How to Play the Great Kachi-Kachi Race{KP}Race {MM} to the top of Mt. Kachi-Kachi!{KP}The controls are almost the same as in an action game!{KP}Move left and right with the directional buttons, and jump with the Circle button!{KP}Hold down the X button to speed up!{KP}Hold the Circle button longer to do a high jump!{KP}Press down on the directional buttons to crouch!{KP}As you run up Mt. Kachi-Kachi, you'll find firewood lying around!{KP}Depending on how much firewood you have, you'll get a bonus!{KP}Aim for the best time and give it your all!
